questions.answer: Missed or late turn signals. Drivers around me (and I) still forget them in the last second before a lane change, which is how a lot of Dallas-area near-misses start. I would solve it the way I started SignalSafe: fuse phone accelerometer, gyro, and GPS, detect an intended turn or merge from motion, and nudge the driver before the maneuver — no extra hardware, no car API. I already filed U.S. Provisional Patent 64/132,977 on that approach. The product version is a lightweight on-device model plus a map-matched warning, not another dashboard camera.
